Prologue:
Welcome to 'The True
Tale of the Xiake',
a brand-new RPG from
Chunlan Studio! It's
a raising sim with
free stat allocation
and an age system,
and the whole game
changes as your
character levels up.
So that you learn
something while
playing, all NPC
dialogue is famous
sayings, so read
them carefully! One
last secret tip:
when you play Xiake,
use Pickpocket a
lot. Also, finding
the hidden storyline
at the start makes
the game a bit
easier~ That's all.
Have fun!

System: This is the Bagua Array. Break it and the Dictionary Array can show its power. It has four parts - Metal, Wood, Water and Earth - each with a guardian to beat. But the maze moves you every 60 seconds, so hurry. Good luck!

Dad, how are you feeling now?

Okay... Take care, both of you. I'm off.
System: Just join any sect, then come back and report.
Sword Saint: You're Mo Jingchou's son?
Yes. Are you the Sword Saint?
Sword Saint: I am.
Why are you locked up in here?
Sword Saint: ...Sigh... Like Hua Yingxiong, I trusted your father's word too much, and this is what it brought me!
Who is my father, really? Was Hua Yingxiong telling the truth?
Sword Saint: Yes! He's the Cult Leader of the Five Poisons Cult. He's always wanted to rule the martial world, and he'll stop at nothing to do it... he won't even spare his own son...
...Sigh... Why does it have to be like this?
Sword Saint: Your father was good at heart. But training with the Minghan Manual he fell into qi deviation, and the chaotic power turned on him, and so...
No, I have to stop him. If this goes on, the whole world will fall into chaos!

Sword Saint: To change this, get BBK's e-dictionaries - the Waiyutong 9188, Download King A100 and Longman 4980, 5980 and 6980 - and lay the Electronic Dictionary Array in the well at the west end of Worryfree Village. It will draw in every demon in the world, down to the faintest trace.
How do I get the Waiyutong 9188? I've already got the other dictionaries.
Sword Saint: The 9188 isn't on sale yet. Ask Zhang Zhanqing in dictionary marketing for one, but you'll need some support rating with the BBK forum. The range: above 0 and below 150.
How do I support the forum?
Sword Saint: ...Go to the internet cafe and get on BBK's forum, of course.
Got it. I'm on my way.
Sword Saint: ...In such a hurry, kid? With your strength now, even if you laid the Dictionary Array, you couldn't open it.
Then what do I do?
Sword Saint: The Minghan Manual holds an ultimate move - Sky Thunder. Just read the book often and you're sure to learn it.
Got it. I'm off, then.
Sword Saint: Good luck!
Chunlan Guardian: The hint's obvious enough, ha ha.

Doctor Wan: Have a look in the Central Plains. They might be there.
Doctor Wan: They are Wake Fruit, Butter Tea, Jade Peony, Red Azalea and Red Whisk, probably found only in the Central Plains. Your father hasn't got long, so hurry!
Doctor Wan: Found the Dragon Cauldron and Samadhi Fire?

Doctor Wan: There's a dark aura on your father's face, perhaps from the climate of the Western Regions. Add overwork, and the result is a deep coma - what modern medicine calls 'intermittent anemia'. In other words...
